rows.essential_qualification_required: Master’s Degree in Natural Sciences (Wildlife Science/ Zoology/ Ecology/ Environmental Sciences/ Geoinformatics/ Remote Sensing/ GIS/ Forestry Sciences/ freshwater ecology) from a recognized institute/ University AND Two years of experience (After obtaining Master’s Degree)
rows.desirable_qualification: Experience in Freshwater Biodiversity survey, assessment of impact of hydro-electric project on aquatic biodiversity, hydrological modelling, species distribution analysis, eflow assessment data analysis and report writing with publication on aquatic flora and fauna.

rows.essential_qualification_required: Master’s Degree in Natural Sciences (Wildlife Science/ Zoology/ Ecology/ Environmental Sciences/ freshwater ecology/ Life Sciences) from a recognized institute/ University
rows.desirable_qualification: Experience in aquatic biodiversity surveys and data analysis preferably related to aquatic ecosystems.

rows.essential_qualification_required: Master’s Degree in any Social Science Discipline (Geography/ Economics/ Social Work/ Anthropology) from recognized institute/ University
rows.desirable_qualification: Experience of social survey, data analysis and report writing.

rows.essential_qualification_required: Master’s Degree in Engineering/ Technology (Remote Sensing and GIS/ Geoinformatics) OR Master’s Degree in Natural Sciences (Wildlife Science/ Zoology/ Ecology/ Environmental Sciences/ Life Sciences/ Remote Sensing and GIS/ Geoinformatics) from recognized institute/ University
rows.desirable_qualification: Experience of Hydrological modelling, species distribution modelling, Impact of the hydro-electric project, eflow assessment.

rows.essential_qualification_required: Bachelor’s Degree in Science (Wildlife Science/ Zoology/ Ecology/ Marine Sciences / Marine Biology/ Environmental Sciences/ Geoinformatics/ Life Sciences/ Agricultural/ Forestry) from recognized institute/ University
rows.desirable_qualification: Experience of aquatic biodiversity surveys and data analysis, preferably related to aquatic ecosystems. Preference for Master’s Degree in Natural Sciences/ social science/ freshwater ecology. For Nicobar: Curiosity for ecological research, enthusiasm for arduous field work in remote locations with limited logistics. Master's degree preferred.

rows.essential_qualification_required: Graduation degree in any discipline from recognized institute/ University
rows.desirable_qualification: Candidates with Economics/communication background will be preferred. Should be proficient in English and using MS-Excel.

rows.essential_qualification_required: Bachelor’s Degree in Science (Wildlife Science/ Zoology/ Ecology/ Marine Sciences / Marine Biology/ Environmental Sciences/ Geoinformatics/ Life Sciences/ Agricultural/ Forestry) from recognized institute/ University
rows.desirable_qualification: Candidates with enthusiasm to work in coastal and marine systems, strong interest for scientific research, and ability to undertake arduous field work in remote islands with limited logistics. Candidates from A&N Islands preferred.

rows.essential_qualification_required: Four Years Bachelor’s Degree (4 Yr BSc degree as per National Education Policy) in Natural Sciences (Wildlife Science/ Zoology/ Biology/ Ecology/ Environmental Sciences/ Life Sciences) AND Four years of experience in R&D in Industrials or Science & Technology Institutions or Scientific activities and Services; OR Master’s Degree in Natural Sciences AND Four years of experience in R&D; OR Doctoral Degree in Science.
rows.desirable_qualification: Experience in environmental and social safeguards for conservation/development projects, social impact assessment, community and livelihood assessments, stakeholder engagement, FPIC, grievance redress mechanisms, and IPPs/LRPs. Experience working with tribal/Indigenous and forest-dependent communities preferred.

rows.post: Project Associate II (Capacity Development / Monitoring Specialist)
rows.essential_qualification_required: Four Years Bachelor’s Degree (as per National Education Policy) in Natural Sciences (Wildlife Science / Biology / Botany / Zoology / Ecology / Environmental Science or related disciplines) AND two years of relevant experience in R&D / scientific activities; OR Master’s Degree in Natural Sciences AND two years of relevant experience.
rows.desirable_qualification: Experience in community-based conservation, institutional strengthening, capacity development of EDCs/CBOs, needs assessment, training delivery, community mobilisation, conservation planning, and participatory wildlife/habitat monitoring. Hands-on experience with camera traps, GPS, and data collection tools.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Monthly emoluments for the advertised positions are structured as follows: Senior Project Associate: Rs. 57,000 + HRA Project Associate II: Rs. 42,000 + HRA (for NET or GATE qualified candidates); Rs. 33,000 + HRA (for non-NET or non-GATE qualified candidates) Project Associate I / Project Associate I (Social) / Project Associate I (Spatial analyst): Rs. 37,000 + HRA (for NET or GATE qualified candidates); Rs. 30,000 + HRA (for non-NET or non-GATE qualified candidates) Project Assistant: Rs. 27,000 + HRA Administrative Assistant: Rs. 24,000 + HRA The project duration for most positions is one year, with certain project durations noted as one year (likely extended or likely to be extended).

content_sections.heading: WII Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Candidate will implement the objectives of the project and will carry field survey, preparation of technical reports on freshwater biodiversity conservation. Candidate will collect data on aquatic biodiversity, literature review, data analysis, report writing. Conduct social survey, data analysis, and report writing. Data collection on aquatic biodiversity, data analysis, report writing. Data collection on aquatic biodiversity, data analysis, and report writing. Assisting the research team in logistics, maintenance of stock registers, and project accounts. Assisting the team in data collection on movement ecology, habitat parameters, sample collection for population genetics work, logistics, sea turtle nesting across beaches, basecamp maintenance, monitoring beach dynamics, satellite tagging, and other project-related activities. Provide technical support to the SPMU in strategic planning, implementation of project activities, facilitating consultative meetings, ensuring coordination, guiding the preparation and monitoring of safeguard plans (IPPs and LRPs), assessing environmental and social safeguard risks, ensuring Free, Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC), and managing the Grievance Redress Mechanism (GRM). Conduct needs assessments of Eco-Development Councils (EDCs) and Community-Based Organisations (CBOs), develop community engagement processes, design capacity-building programmes, organise training for EDCs/CBOs and paravets, support community conservation institutions, and monitor training activities. Establish participatory community-based monitoring systems, build patrolling and wildlife monitoring teams, deliver training on wild cat habitat management, coordinate monitoring equipment use, develop community participation and incentive mechanisms, and support data sharing.

Keep scanned copies of educational certificates, marksheets, work experience proof, reserved category certificates, UGC/CSIR NET scorecards, publications, fee receipt, passport size photo, and digital signature ready in advance. Pay the applicable application fee through online banking, NEFT, RTGS, or electronic mode to the designated bank account (Account Name: RRP Cell Revolving/ Director Wildlife Institute of India, Union Bank of India, Branch: Chandrabani, Dehradun, Account No.: 518502010059776, IFSC Code: UBIN0551856). Fill out the online application form with accurate details strictly as per educational marksheets. Upload the application fee payment receipt along with all required supporting documents. Submit the online application form before the closing date. Candidates applying for more than one position must submit separate applications along with separate supporting documents and fees for each position.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of applicants for online interviews will be based on essential qualifications, age limit, percentage of marks in Bachelor’s/Master’s degrees, specialization relevance, research experience, and publications. Based on screening criteria, the top ten (10) short-listed candidates against each advertised project/position will be called for interviews. The selection criteria marks are allotted as follows: Field/Lab/Project Assistant category: Bachelor's Degree percentage (25 Marks) and Specialization relevance via internship/volunteering/experience (25 Marks) — Total 50 Marks. Project Associate - I category: Master's Degree percentage (25 Marks) and Specialization relevance via internship/volunteering/experience (25 Marks) — Total 50 Marks. Project Associate – II/ Senior Project Associate categories: UGC/CSIR/ICAR NET with JRFship or WII-NET passed (5 Marks), Post Graduation marks (25 Marks), Research/Work Experience (10 Marks), and Publications in journals/conferences/book chapters (10 Marks) — Total 50 Marks.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for WII Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 1 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are advertised in WII Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 19 vacancies across different categories of positions for research projects have been advertised.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for General category candidates?
faq.answer: General category candidates must pay an application fee of Rs. 500/-.

faq.question: Q4. Are SC/ST/OBC candidates exempted from the application fee?
faq.answer: Candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC/EWS and Physically Challenged categories are exempted from the application fee, but they must pay Rs. 100/- as an application processing fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for Project Associate II positions?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for Project Associate II positions is 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit for Project Assistant and Administrative Assistant positions?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for Project Assistant and Administrative Assistant positions is 50 years.

faq.question: Q7. How many positions can a candidate apply for?
faq.answer: A candidate may apply for a maximum of two advertised positions, provided they meet the relevance and essential/desirable requisites, by submitting separate online application forms and fees for each.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for WII project positions?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on essential qualifications, age limit, marks percentage, experience, and publications, following which top shortlisted candidates are called for an online interview.

faq.question: Q9. Do currently employed WII project staff need an NOC?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates presently working with WII projects or research activities must attach a recent No Objection Certificate obtained within one month from the last date of application.
